links.comparator_used: Direct contamination (prompt injection) without preprocessing defense
links.outcome: Case fidelity (slot-level F1) and turn-target hit rate under direct contamination
links.effect: Direct contamination without defense: fidelity 0.098 (95% CI 0.052-0.144), hit rate 0.077 (95% CI 0.034-0.119). With preprocessing defense: fidelity 0.945 (95% CI 0.938-0.952), hit rate 0.942 (95% CI 0.930-0.955). Clean baseline: fidelity 0.947, hit rate 0.946.
links.quote: With preprocessing defense, performance returned to near-clean levels (fidelity, 0.945; 95% CI, 0.938-0.952; hit rate, 0.942; 95% CI, 0.930-0.955).
